title: Rank badges
mode-help: A user gets the highest rank in the list whose thresholds they meet. Level 1 is the starting rank: if its thresholds are 0, every user has it. For every other rank a threshold of 0 means "no requirement" and never grants the rank by itself.
reputation-disabled: Reputation is disabled on this forum (Settings → Reputation), so every mode counts posts only, in posts and on profiles.
langs-help: One name column per language code (e.g. en-GB, pl, de). An empty name uses the translation from the plugin's language files (default ranks) or the first name given. Names in languages removed from this list are deleted when you save.
hide-group-badges: Hide group title badges in posts of users with a group badge
category-moderators: Category moderators get the "Global Moderators" badge
auto-inject-help: "Add badge to posts automatically" uses the theme's custom profile info slot (Harmony, Persona). Turn it off if your theme prints the badge itself:
ranks-help: Order matters: level = position in the list. Thresholds are whole numbers written with digits. Images: upload (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to %1 KB) or paste a URL starting with / or https://; square, at least 64 px, shown at 20 px in posts. Colour is optional (accent of the badge).
groups-help: Members of these groups get a group badge instead of a rank. Precedence: administrators, then Global Moderators (including category moderators when that option is on), then the other groups in list order. Badges of hidden groups are shown only with "Show if hidden". Icon: a Font Awesome name such as fa-shield-halved.
preview-help: Saved settings, rendered by the server as on the forum.
load-error: Cannot load the settings (%1). Saving is disabled so that the stored settings are not overwritten; reload the page.
save-blocked: The settings were not loaded, so they cannot be saved. Reload the page.
defaults-restored: Default ranks and group badges restored. Click Save to apply.
preset-loaded: Preset "%1" loaded. Click Save to apply.
preset-bad-file: Preset "%1": an image with an invalid file name was skipped.
upload-type: Only PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG images can be uploaded.
upload-size: The image is larger than %1 KB.
uploaded: Image uploaded. Click Save to apply.
error.invalid-list: The rank or group table is not valid. Reload the page and try again.
error.too-many-groups: At most %1 group badges are allowed.
error.threshold: Rank %1: thresholds must be whole numbers of 0 or more, written with digits only.
error.rank-name: Rank %1 has no name. Type a name in at least one language.
error.group-name: Group badge %1 needs a group name.
warn.no-ranks: The rank list is empty: users get no rank badge, only group badges.
warn.unreachable: Rank %1 cannot be reached: all its counted thresholds are 0 (only the first rank starts at 0).
warn.order: Rank %1 has a lower threshold than the rank before it. Ranks are evaluated by position, so a more active user may get a lower-looking rank.
warn.equal: Rank %1 has the same thresholds as the rank before it, so the rank before it is never shown.
warn.group-missing: Group "%1" does not exist, so its badge is not shown. If a group with this exact name is created later, its members get the badge.
warn.group-hidden: Group "%1" is hidden, so its badge is not shown unless "Show if hidden" is ticked.
update.private: update it with the deployment script
update.check-help: Once a day the forum fetches the latest version number of this plugin from updates.wirelab.pl: a plain GET request, nothing about the forum is sent. When this is off, no requests are made.
